instruction.text: You would like to go on a journey from your home to Yarlington. Answer the question.

atoms.a: You need to have arrived by 2pm, and the journey should take about two hours. What time would be sensible to leave at?

feedback.correct: It is always a good idea to set off a little early, just in case there are delays.
feedback.wrong: Leaving early is sensible, but giving yourself 7 hours might be a bit excessive!

instruction.text: Your mum is going to drive you to the bus stop. Which safety device must you use?

feedback.end: You might also need a booster seat so that the seatbelt works properly.

instruction.text: You are dropped off at the bus stop. Now you need to take a bus to Upperton Station. Select where this is on the stop lists.
Which number bus should you take?
You have just boarded the bus. Complete the dialogue with the driver.

hint.text: You are taking the bus to Upperton Station.

atoms.b: Good afternoon, please can I buy a ticket to ((++Upperton_Station Yarding))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch='+1st'>Good Afternoon, please can I buy a ticket to Upperton Station.</prosody>

atoms.b: Of course! That will be £3.50 please.
atoms.sound: Of course! That will be three pounds and fifty pence please.

atoms.b: Okay. How many ((++stops bends)) will it be?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch='+1st'>Okay. How many stops will it be?</prosody>

instruction.text: Upperton station has just been announced as the next stop. Which button will you have to press?
You have arrived at Upperton station, but you still need to take a train to Yarlington. Look at the departure board and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Does this train go to Yarlington?
Which platform does the train leave from?
What time does the train depart at?

text: Great work! The train arrives in Yarlington at 13:58 - right on time!

instruction.text: Can you put the stages of your journey in order?

feedback.end: Wow, that was a long journey! For journeys like this, you should always travel with an adult.
